service.name_zh: NTPU AI 智慧問答助理
service.deployment_zh: 前端靜態資源與 API 由同一個 Cloudflare Worker 提供；FastAPI、FAISS 與 BM25 執行於 Cloudflare Container，對話狀態保存於 Durable Object storage，API 金鑰以 Worker Secret 管理。
service.deployment_en: One Cloudflare Worker serves the static frontend and API gateway; FastAPI, FAISS, and BM25 run in a Cloudflare Container, conversation state is stored in Durable Object storage, and API keys are managed as Worker Secrets.

faqs.answer_zh: 目前可查詢體育室、通識教育中心、語言中心、教務處、學務處、人事室與總務處的相關規定、辦法、公告與常見問題。你也可以詢問本系統的服務範圍、使用方式、資料來源、限制與隱私提醒。
faqs.answer_en: You can currently ask about regulations, policies, announcements, and common questions from the Physical Education Office, Center for General Education, Language Center, Office of Academic Affairs, Office of Student Affairs, Personnel Office, and Office of General Affairs. You may also ask about this system's coverage, usage, sources, limitations, and privacy guidance.

aliases_en: Which university units can I ask about?
faqs.answer_zh: 目前支援七個單位：體育室、通識教育中心、語言中心、教務處、學務處、人事室與總務處。各單位可查內容依目前已匯入的官方資料而定。
faqs.answer_en: Seven units are currently supported: the Physical Education Office, Center for General Education, Language Center, Office of Academic Affairs, Office of Student Affairs, Personnel Office, and Office of General Affairs. Available topics depend on the official materials currently indexed.

faqs.question_en: How do I use this system?
faqs.answer_zh: 直接在輸入框用自然語言描述問題即可；若知道處室、身分、學制、年度或規定名稱，一併提供會更容易找到正確資料。回答後建議打開來源連結核對官方原文，也可以針對同一主題繼續追問。
faqs.answer_en: Type your question in natural language. Including the office, your role, program, year, or policy name helps retrieve the right material. Open the source link to verify the official text, and you may continue with follow-up questions on the same topic.

faqs.question_zh: 使用這個系統需要登入嗎？
faqs.question_en: Do I need to sign in?
aliases_en: Do I need a university account?
faqs.answer_zh: 目前使用 aia.ntpu.ai 不需要登入或註冊，也不需要安裝應用程式。請勿在對話中輸入密碼、身分證字號、學號或其他敏感個人資料。
faqs.answer_en: aia.ntpu.ai currently requires no sign-in, registration, or app installation. Do not enter passwords, ID numbers, student numbers, or other sensitive personal data in the chat.

faqs.question_en: Can I ask questions in English?
faqs.answer_zh: 可以。介面可切換中文或英文，也可直接用中文或英文提問。由於多數校務原始資料是中文，重要規定仍建議打開來源連結核對原文。
faqs.answer_en: Yes. The interface can be switched between Chinese and English, and you can ask in either language. Because most original university documents are in Chinese, verify important rules through the linked source text.

faqs.question_en: Where does your information come from?
aliases_en: What is in the knowledge base?
faqs.answer_zh: 知識庫以國立臺北大學各處室公開網站、公告、常見問答與 PDF 法規辦法為主，經爬取、整理、切塊與索引後供檢索。回答會盡量附上對應的官方來源連結；系統自我說明則連到本系統說明頁。
faqs.answer_en: The knowledge base primarily uses public NTPU office webpages, announcements, FAQs, and PDF regulations. These are collected, cleaned, chunked, and indexed for retrieval. Answers aim to include the corresponding official source link; system-related answers link to this system guide.

faqs.question_zh: AI 的回答一定正確嗎？
faqs.question_en: Are the AI answers always correct?
faqs.answer_zh: 不一定。回答由 AI 根據檢索到的資料整理，仍可能誤解、不完整或使用到較舊內容。涉及學分、資格、期限、權益或人事規定時，請以來源連結中的官方公告、正式函文與承辦單位確認為準。
faqs.answer_en: Not always. Answers are generated from retrieved material and may still be misunderstood, incomplete, or outdated. For credits, eligibility, deadlines, rights, or personnel rules, rely on the linked official notice or document and confirm with the responsible office.

faqs.question_en: How often is the data updated?
aliases_en: How often is the knowledge base updated?
faqs.answer_zh: 知識庫會隨資料整理與系統部署更新，但目前不是與各處室網站即時同步，也不承諾固定更新週期。最新公告、緊急資訊與正式期限請以各處室官網為準。
faqs.answer_en: The knowledge base is refreshed when source materials are curated and a new system version is deployed, but it is not synchronized with office websites in real time and no fixed update interval is guaranteed. Check official office sites for the latest or urgent information and deadlines.

faqs.answer_zh: 系統會用 conversation ID 與結構化狀態維持同一對話的追問脈絡，並會產生操作與品質改善所需的服務日誌。問題與必要上下文會傳給設定的 AI 服務以產生回答。請勿輸入密碼、身分證字號、學號、金融資訊或其他敏感個資。
faqs.answer_en: The system uses a conversation ID and structured state to keep follow-up context, and service logs may be produced for operation and quality improvement. Your question and necessary context are sent to the configured AI service to generate an answer. Do not enter passwords, ID or student numbers, financial information, or other sensitive personal data.

aliases_en: Do you remember the previous question?
Can I ask another question about the same topic?
faqs.answer_zh: 可以。同一個對話會保存結構化的主題、處室與前次來源，短追問會先改寫成完整問題再檢索。若你換了主題，系統會重新判斷處室；若指代不清，系統可能先請你補充。開啟新對話後不會沿用舊對話脈絡。
faqs.answer_en: Yes. Within one conversation, structured topic, office, and previous-source state is retained, and short follow-ups are rewritten into standalone questions before retrieval. A topic change triggers routing again; unclear references may prompt a clarification. Starting a new chat does not reuse the old context.

faqs.question_zh: 為什麼有些問題回答不了？
faqs.question_en: Why can't some questions be answered?
faqs.answer_zh: 常見原因包括：問題不屬於目前七處室或系統說明範圍、官方資料尚未匯入、問題條件不足，或檢索到的證據不足以安全回答。你可以補上處室、身分、學制、年度或規定名稱；若仍沒有資料，系統會明確說明目前不支援，而不自行猜測。
faqs.answer_en: Common reasons include: the topic is outside the seven supported offices and system guide, the official material has not been indexed, the question lacks key details, or retrieved evidence is insufficient. Add the office, role, program, year, or policy name. If evidence is still unavailable, the system should clearly say it is not currently supported rather than guess.

faqs.question_zh: 這個系統與 ChatGPT 有什麼不同？
faqs.question_en: How is this different from ChatGPT?
aliases_zh: 和一般聊天機器人差別
aliases_en: How is this different from a general chatbot?
faqs.answer_zh: 本系統是以北大七處室公開資料為範圍的校務 RAG 服務：先檢索 repository 建立的校務知識庫，再由模型整理並附來源。一般 ChatGPT 的知識與用途更廣，但不一定使用本系統已整理的校務資料、處室路由與來源格式。兩者都可能出錯，正式規定仍以官方文件為準。
faqs.answer_en: This is an NTPU administrative RAG service scoped to public materials from seven offices: it retrieves from the curated university knowledge base before a model composes an answer with sources. General ChatGPT is broader, but does not necessarily use this system's curated office data, routing, or source format. Both can be wrong; official documents remain authoritative.

faqs.question_en: How does the system find an answer?
faqs.answer_zh: 校務問題會先判斷所屬處室，再將問題改寫為適合檢索的完整查詢，以 FAISS 向量搜尋與 BM25 關鍵詞搜尋找候選資料，經融合與重排序後交給模型整理。只有有足夠證據時才應作答，最後附上來源。SYSTEM 問題則直接從本系統 FAQ 回答，不進入七處室 RAG。
faqs.answer_en: For administrative questions, the system first selects an office, rewrites the question into a retrieval-ready standalone query, combines FAISS vector search with BM25 keyword search, fuses and reranks candidates, and then lets the model compose an answer. It should answer only when evidence is sufficient and include sources. SYSTEM questions are answered directly from this system FAQ instead of the seven-office RAG.

faqs.question_en: Does the system support voice or images?
faqs.answer_zh: 目前介面支援麥克風語音輸入與圖片上傳。語音會先轉成文字再走一般問答流程；圖片由視覺模型分析，目前不會自動與七處室 RAG 文件合併，因此圖片中的重要校務資訊仍應核對官方來源。
faqs.answer_en: The interface supports microphone input and image uploads. Voice is transcribed before entering the normal question flow. Images are analyzed by a vision model and are not automatically combined with seven-office RAG documents, so important administrative information in an image should still be checked against official sources.

faqs.question_en: What should I do if an answer is wrong?
aliases_en: How do I report an error?
faqs.answer_zh: 可使用回答下方的讚或倒讚回饋，選擇資訊錯誤、過時、答非所問、過於籠統或來源有誤等原因，也可補充不含個資的說明。涉及正式權益時，請同時向原權責處室確認。
faqs.answer_en: Use the thumbs-up or thumbs-down control below an answer. You can mark incorrect, outdated, off-topic, vague, or bad-source issues and add a note without personal data. For matters affecting formal rights, also confirm with the responsible office.
